title: A Friendship That Lasts
text:
Maria and Tom have been friends since they were children. They live on the same street, so they often walk to school together. Maria likes books, and Tom likes football. They still share their favorite things with each other.

Last year, Tom moved to a new city for his job. Maria was sad, but they talk on the phone every Sunday. They say that good friends stay close, even when they are far away.

questions.text: Where do Maria and Tom live?
How often do Maria and Tom talk on the phone?
Why was Maria sad when Tom moved to a new city?
options: She did not like his new job
She wanted to move there too

questions.text: What is the main idea of the passage?
options: Friends can stay close even when they are apart
Moving to a new city is always easy
School is the best place to make friends
Football is more fun than books

vocabulary.definition: to have or use something together with someone
near in distance or in feelings

paragraph_translations: María y Tom son amigos desde que eran niños. Viven en la misma calle, así que a menudo caminan juntos a la escuela. A María le gustan los libros y a Tom le gusta el fútbol. Todavía comparten sus cosas favoritas el uno con el otro.
El año pasado, Tom se mudó a una nueva ciudad por su trabajo. María estaba triste, pero hablan por teléfono cada domingo. Dicen que los buenos amigos siguen cerca, incluso cuando están lejos.
